58F, EW EMER. admission from PACU.
OUTCOME: discharged alive to HOME HEALTH CARE
PRESENTING SYMPTOMS: Other ascites; Disturbance of skin sensation
PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS: Chronic cholecystitis
ACTIVE DIAGNOSES: Chronic cholecystitis; Portal vein thrombosis; Encephalopathy, unspecified; Other pancytopenia; Celiac disease; Portal hypertension; Esophageal varices in diseases classified elsewhere, without mention of bleeding; Pulmonary collapse; Other chronic nonalcoholic liver disease; Cirrhosis of liver without mention of alcohol; Other specified disorders of stomach and duodenum; Peritoneal adhesions (postoperative) (postinfection); Diabetes mellitus without mention of complication, type II or unspecified type, not stated as uncontrolled; Unspecified acquired hypothyroidism; Myalgia and myositis, unspecified; Esophageal reflux; Displacement of lumbar intervertebral disc without myelopathy; Migraine, unspecified, without mention of intractable migraine without mention of status migrainosus; Osteoarthrosis, unspecified whether generalized or localized, lower leg

MICROBIOLOGY: none
SERVICES: SURG
WARDS: Transplant
